alex_t: Heads-up — onboarding a community HF model that requires trust_remote_code + custom auto_map classes. Conversion to Redwood loader is failing on special token mapping and chat templates. Posting minimal repro and logs below.

maria_g: Can you paste the error and the model repo link?

alex_t: sure. error when we run `rhf-convert --to=redwood .`:

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "convert.py", line 234, in <module>
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(repo, trust_remote_code=False)
  File ".../transformers/modeling_auto.py", line 412, in from_pretrained
    raise ValueError("Custom class not found in auto_map")
ValueError: Custom class not found in auto_map: 'MyCustomCausal'
```

Also `tokenizer.json` has `special_tokens_map` that references `__pad__` and `__extra_id_0__` but the Redwood tokenizer autoload ends up with different ids, so chat template placeholders like `<|assistant|>` don't line up. Model repo: https://huggingface.co/community/some-model (private snapshot internal).

raj_k: Sounds like two problems: 1) conversion forbids trust_remote_code by default so auto_map classes never register; 2) tokenizer special tokens aren't normalized because we don't run the model's tokenizer init hooks (the ones in trust_remote_code). Quick workaround: run conversion with `--allow-trust` to temporarily import the remote code, or manually patch auto_map mapping in a local shim. But be careful with importing arbitrary code — schedule a security review. :eyes:

sophie_l: FWIW we did a quick quant test (q4_k_mixed) on a small codegen eval harness — quality dropped ~12% pass@1 vs fp16 on the same checkpoints when tokenizer mapping was wrong (likely misaligned BOS/SEP). Need to rerun after fixing token mapping.

alex_t: here's the minimal conversion patch I tested locally that forces the `auto_map` registration from the model's repo but wraps classes behind a safe wrapper (no network calls):

```
# convert_shim.py (sketch)
from importlib import import_module
mod = import_module('modeling_custom')  # from repo when trust_remote_code used
RedwoodModel = safe_wrap(mod.MyCustomCausal)
auto_map['AutoModelForCausalLM']['my_custom'] = RedwoodModel
```

It got past the AutoModel error but tokenizer still had mismatched ids.

maria_g: We should update the converter to: a) optionally import remote init hooks under a sandbox flag, b) mirror special_tokens_map normalization, and c) add a check that chat templates use existing token ids. If any of those fail, conversion should emit a clear warning and a small suggested patch.

raj_k: I'll schedule a quick security vet for `--allow-trust` usage. For now I recommend we add a conversion lint rule that errors if `config.json` contains `auto_map` entries but trust_remote_code is false. That will catch this earlier.

sophie_l: Also add an eval gating step: run the model on the internal chat-template regression suite (5 prompts, 3 seeds) and fail conversion if perplexity/order-of-tokens mismatch > threshold. Saved us time on the earlier Llama fork.

eval-bot: quick run summary (sandbox): https://internal-redwood/bench/1845678901 — q4_k_mixed vs fp16 on small-codegen: delta pass@1 = -12.3%; tokenizer mismatch flagged: 3/5 prompts.

alex_t: plan: maria -> PR to converter (lint + token normalization + suggested patch output). raj -> security review for allow-trust draft. sophie -> re-run eval harness post-converter fix to confirm quant quality. I'll attach the model snapshot and repro steps in the issue.

maria_g: sounds good. I'll open PR + issue tonight and assign reviewers.

raj_k: thanks — ping me when PR is up, will prioritize the review.

sophie_l: adding test cases to regression harness now. :snake: :rocket:

alex_t: thanks all. keeping this thread updated with PR/CI links.
